title: Fix rejected drain PR #157 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72)
description:
Drain PR #157 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-72` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] Scope creep: The implementation includes complex parsing logic for method shorthand, getters/setters, and async methods that goes beyond the specified requirement of 'brace-matching, JS/TS function and arrow forms' — The task only specified function declarations, function expressions, and arrow functions with block bodies, but the implementation adds method shorthand, getters/setters, and async method parsing which expands scope beyond requirements
- [major] Fragile parsing: The implementation uses complex character-level scanning with numerous edge cases and assumptions about JavaScript syntax that are likely to fail on real-world code — The code includes multiple pattern matching approaches with complex backtracking and context checks that are error-prone and not robust for production use
- [major] Silent fallbacks: The implementation has multiple continue statements that silently skip parsing failures without any error reporting or logging — This hides parsing errors and makes debugging difficult when the scanner fails to recognize valid function patterns
- [minor] Code quality: The implementation is 300+ lines of complex parsing logic in a single function, violating the 'small files' principle — The function should be broken down into smaller, focused helper functions for better maintainability
